exclusion_reason: Bounded modern-API signal and live WebGPU and memory64 capability can be observed, but x86-64 and D3D10/11 prerequisite research and modern runtime mapping remain incomplete.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-026 and an approved report compare D3D12 and Vulkan requirement to current WebGPU descriptor, shader, synchronization, memory, CPU, and browser capability.
expected_failing_assertion: No credible browser mapping for the modern API fixture has been demonstrated.
active_gate_evidence: The product combines bounded D3D12 or Vulkan-era signal with live ephemeral browser capability and returns defer without a support claim.
procedure: Build a requirement and feature-gap matrix from current primary sources and prerequisite result.
Prototype the highest-risk descriptor, synchronization, shader, or memory path on each required browser profile.
pass_criterion: The report contains reproducible evidence rather than roadmap aspiration.
It recommends bounded promotion, continued research, or rejection without expanding a support claim.
